description.value: Steve's Poké Bar is a Hawaiian-style poké chain founded by Steve Huynh, who grew up between Vancouver and Honolulu learning authentic poké preparation from family recipes. The restaurant has been voted Vancouver's number-one poké spot and has accumulated over 10,000 five-star Google reviews across its Lower Mainland locations. A touring cyclist stopping here can build a customizable, protein-rich bowl from fresh fish, tofu, and a range of toppings, with both in-store pick-up and delivery available.
